products.title: Ultra Performance Gasket Replacement Kit
products.body_html:
After long and intensive use of your Big Green Egg, the felt strip on the upper edge of the ceramic base and the lower edge of the ceramic lid will wear out. Since this strip protects the ceramic and regulates perfect air circulation, it is recommended to replace it in time. And you can easily do that with this Gasket Kit. The roll of felt is self-adhesive and the strip is easy to replace.

Regardless of which Egg model you have, we have a roll of self-adhesive felt for it. The felt can withstand extremely high temperatures and you don't need any glue. Even new do-it-yourselfers can handle this task without problems.

If you prefer a Big Green Egg expert to do it for you, choose the annual maintenance plan. Then we'll replace the felt for you.

products.title: Stainless Steel Grid

products.title: rEGGulator Vent Cap
products.body_html:
The new and robust rEGGulator can be adjusted with extreme precision. It is made of durable cast iron, and with the cool silicone grip, you can easily increase or decrease airflow without burning your fingers. Another practical feature: we have already applied a coating that prevents rust formation, allowing you to leave it on the EGG after use.

Big Green Egg was already known for its precise temperature control, but after two years of product development, the highest degree of perfection has now been achieved. The new patented air vent is the successor to the metal top and has an ergonomic design, as well as improvements in usability and durability. If you completely close the air supply, the EGG becomes 100% airtight, causing it to extinguish. If it starts to rain while you're using the EGG, you can give the air vent its own rain protection with the Rain Cap accessory to prevent rain from entering the EGG.

With its expansive 3-inch (8 cm) dial, it offers unparalleled accuracy in monitoring your egg's internal temperature. Seamlessly integrating with XXLarge to MiniMax models, this gauge empowers you to achieve culinary perfection across a wide range of cooking techniques. Its hermetically sealed, heavy-duty construction ensures reliable performance in any outdoor cooking scenario.

  • Temperature range: Up to 750°F / 400°C
  • Compatibility: XXLarge, XLarge, Large, Medium, Small, MiniMax eggs (does not fit the Mini)
  • Made in USA with premium materials
  • Easy installation with included silicone washer and retaining clip

This gauge doesn't just measure temperature; it provides the insight you need to master the art of outdoor cooking. By offering precise, real-time feedback, it allows you to fine-tune your approach, whether you're smoking a brisket low and slow or searing steaks at high heat. Its robust design withstands the rigors of outdoor use, while its sleek aesthetic complements the egg's iconic shape. For the discerning outdoor chef who demands nothing but the best, this temperature gauge is an indispensable tool in creating memorable culinary experiences.
